description: This file defines the interface and class structure for the PackageManager plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations, interface implementations, and notification handling mechanisms for package download and installation events.

classes.name: PackageManager
classes.description: Main plugin class managing package download and installation, implementing plugin and JSONRPC interfaces, and handling notifications.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: Nested class handling remote connection notifications and package download/installation events, used internally within PackageManager.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the PackageManager plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the PackageManager plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns information about the PackageManager plugin.
